components.text:
Not distributed with this repository. The runtime reads Gemma 2 weights that the user downloads
themselves; those weights are provided under and subject to the Gemma Terms of Use found at
https://ai.google.dev/gemma/terms, and their use is subject to the Gemma Prohibited Use Policy at
https://ai.google.dev/gemma/prohibited_use_policy. This repository contains an independent
implementation of the Gemma 2 architecture and no Gemma weights or other Gemma materials.
